title: Certified Computer Accountancy | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified Computer Accountancy. Category: Development. Duration: 3 months. Description: Offered alongside Certified Computer Operator for young people in Karachi entering IT. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
